name: @litter/app
description: Shared Pounce application source — screens, components, state, and services consumed by both the mobile (apps/mobile) and desktop (desktop/) apps. Ships raw TS/TSX; each app's Metro compiles it against its own React Native version. Platform divergence lives in .macos/.windows platform files, never in per-app copies.

scripts.typecheck: echo 'typechecked by consumers (apps/mobile + desktop) — 39 platform variants + per-app RN version make a standalone tsc unsound'
